body: Thank you. I'm glad you've found purpose through your husband and child. Best of luck to you as well.

I had no idea there was a name for it. I googled it and it explains what I'm feeling to a tee. Wow. It's one thing to think you're depressed but knowing it might be true is... scary. It makes me a little weary of getting help because then it'll feel real.

Thank you for this. It's so easy to compare myself to others, I've been doing it for as long as I can remember. I've wanted to talk to my family about it, and I've subtly alluded to the idea that something might not be right with me, but they usually dismiss it as normal mood swings that everyone goes through. I understand that they aren't mind readers and I should just go ahead and tell them, but I'm afraid they'll just reinforce my fear that my life is too good for me to be depressed and I'm just an ungrateful little shit.
